thread:
Nina: Quick note from pairing with SRE on batching/windowing for obs ingest. Need to capture the invariants before RFC follow-up.
Rahul: sure — what are the key invariants?
Nina: 1) per-tenant event_time monotonicity must be preserved by any batcher. 2) batches must include first_event_ts and last_event_ts. 3) provide a seq_no per tenant+stream to detect reorder.
Sam: concrete failure we saw: when a shard rebalanced, batches straddled minute boundaries and cost bins got off by several buckets.
Nina: exactly. That led to query mismatches and billing reconciliation headaches.
Rahul: solution idea: include sequence and window markers in envelope; stitcher will use them to place events deterministically.
Sam: overhead? seq_no (64-bit) + two timestamps = ~16 bytes/event. negligible.
Nina: also policy: edge prefix caching is ok but must be tenant opt-in. For opt-in flow: observe -> compare -> promote.
Rahul: and require an audit log entry on any tenant opt-in toggle.
ops-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: ingest-batcher v1.1 -> 2026-04-05 04:00 UTC, 5% traffic.
Sam: I'll add a short appendix with our microbench numbers to the RFC.
Nina: thanks — I'll draft the RFC follow-up with invariants, opt-in flow, seq semantics, and sampling probe. End.
